headline: Miss Israel booed on stage during national costume segment at Miss Universe pageant
label: NEWS
caption:
The Miss Universe pageant sparked outrage online and in the room after Miss Israel stepped out in a disputed costume. 👑

According to Middle East Eye, Miss Israel 2026 Danielle Yablonka was met with loud boos from the audience in Puerto Rico while wearing a cape depicting olive trees and the Al Aqsa Mosque complex.

Social media users heavily criticized the outfit and the host introduction, pointing out that East Jerusalem is considered occupied under international law and that symbols like Jaffa oranges and olive trees are core to Palestinian identity.

Critics on X also slammed the timing of the display amid the ongoing war in Gaza and rising settler attacks in the West Bank, while others noted similarities to the previous year costume worn by Miss Palestine.
